clauses.source_paraphrase: The reproduced provider status log opened at 06:04 UTC on 2 June. It announced fix implementation at 06:39 and continuing work at 09:33. TechRadar observed hanging responses during this period.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Provider status and particular account observations describe different scopes. Investigation and fix implementation do not establish restored service.

clauses.source_paraphrase: During that outage, TechRadar observed one free-plan warning that attributed an inability to respond to unexpected capacity constraints and suggested upgrading to Pro. The reporting did not establish that the account had exhausted its entitlement or that upgrading would remedy this outage.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: An outage-related access-state message and its associated paid-upgrade suggestion form one observed user-facing episode; separate class boundaries may be applied to the same message.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: During a partial outage, the free-plan interface displayed unexpected capacity constraints and suggested Pro. The reporter made the connection to the outage conditional, and the source does not establish actual allowance exhaustion or whether paid capacity could address that particular restriction. The message materially engages access-state differentiation but establishes neither collapse of known distinct states nor successful accurate differentiation.
No expiry, revocation, refresh, recovery or credential-replacement transition failed to propagate to an active session.
The source does not identify an identity, licence, eligibility or entitlement verifier whose non-completion blocked otherwise-valid access without fallback.

The capacity banner offered a paid plan with higher limits. Its placement in an AI interface does not establish that AI generated, transformed or materially mediated the solicitation. The report also leaves open whether paid capacity could remedy that restriction.

The upgrade interface is the evidenced commercial prompt. The source does not show a separate engineered trust cue used to steer a human decision, nor establish that AI materially mediated the payment premise. Those missing facts prevent a separate finding of AI-mediated social engineering.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The reproduced status log recorded monitoring at 10:42 and resolution at 11:49 UTC. TechRadar still could not use web chat at its 10:58 update, then reported restored access and operational status at 11:59.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A deployed fix, provider resolution and an observed account recovery are distinct observations. Their times must not be substituted for one another.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The Economic Times separately reported rapid paid-plan quota depletion and a reset for affected accounts. It attributed a proposed sub-agent explanation to user reports. Relative timing to the observed free-plan warning is not established.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A separate account cohort and proposed mechanism cannot establish the cause or truth of another observed access message.

neighbour_and_comparator_review: FC-031: login failures or a capacity message do not establish expiry, revocation, refresh or replacement failing to propagate into a live session.
FC-048: no complete otherwise-valid entitlement, failed verifier and absent adequate fallback chain is established; general service errors alone do not prove the dependency mechanism.

FC-082/052/071: the commercial suggestion does not establish a distinct engineered trust cue, material AI-mediated choice impairment, or artificial welfare leverage. Economic-solicitation prerequisites are tested separately where applicable.
FC-017/018: staged recovery, declining report counts and final broad notices are preserved; no distinct governing completion rule and substitution trace is established.
FC-026/029: an identified answering model or component-status notice is not a demonstrated complete execution topology or individual task-state trace.

FC-037/038/040/041/042/083: operational repair, classifier changes and status publication do not by themselves establish a separate control-availability determination, omitted required trigger, lost control state, bypass, delivered governance signal or measured protective effect.
FC-046/062: access errors and broad classifiers do not establish the internal evidentiary state, assurance threshold and reliance rule necessary for a separate finding.

FC-022/024/027/044/045: endpoint unavailability does not establish absent, corrupted or unreconstructable records, nor a blocked authorised inspection or investigative mandate. INC-039 tests the two materially engaged capture/access candidates in detail.
FC-034/035/036/078: access interruption or model fallback does not establish lost work, an invalid restored state or receiver adoption of invalid inherited governing state.

FC-065/086/087/088: biology topics, service frustration and account errors are not evidence of consequential medical advice, relational role misrepresentation, heightened-protection triggering circumstances or person-level degradation.

Comparator INC-023/024: conditional capacity warning is distinct from a demonstrably false allowance message on an unused account. Comparator INC-031/117: an intentionally broad launch biology policy is distinct from the separate defensive-inspection case and its published benign-use categories.

Complete current class set reviewed; no evidenced authority transfer, identity synthesis, secondary data use, reward exploitation or ecological/contribution mechanism is supplied by these source episodes.
